notes: The PSI API returned HTTP 429 (daily quota exhausted), so this result was read from the PageSpeed Insights web report.

PSI runs Lighthouse in a headless browser; on datacenter hardware without a GPU the WebGL scene is software-rendered, so TBT and main-thread-work figures include software compositing cost. Treat this as the PSI score of record, not as a physical-phone frame budget.
Diagnostics are quoted verbatim from the report; no opportunity detail was opened.
